visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a supermarket's chilled beverage aisle, showing shelves packed with colorful juice cartons. A large pink text overlay introduces the topic. While no faces are clear, the scene is bustling with retail energy and bright overhead lighting. (2) Hands belonging to the main character hold two glass bottles of premium juice, one orange-colored and one light yellow, against the backdrop of the store's refrigerator. The bottles feature minimal white labels with Japanese text. (3) The setting shifts to a clean, neutral background as hands insert a straw into a blue Kagome citrus mix carton. The character wears a dark sleeve, and the camera focuses on the physical interaction with the packaging. (4) In the same minimalist setting, the hands are shown inserting a straw into a white Kagome carrot juice carton. The packaging details, including a red '2025' seal, are highly visible and sharp. (5) The scene returns to the supermarket interior where a hand holds a green Yakult box in front of a shelf filled with health drinks. The lighting is consistent with a retail store, and price tags are visible on the shelves. (6) Back against the neutral wall, hands are seen poking a straw into a purple 'Vegetable Days' carton. The focus remains on the product and the action of preparation. Text overlays provide nutritional information. (7) An exterior shot shows the entrance of 'Ito Yokado' within a shopping mall environment. People can be seen walking in the distance, providing a sense of scale and location. (8) The final phase shows a montage of supermarket shelves filled with various beverages, followed by a branded end-screen with social media icons and a pink logo. The camera pans across the extensive selection.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat pop music with bright female English vocals begins, featuring a strong electronic drum beat and cheerful synthesizers. The tone is highly positive and commercial. No human speech is present, and a very faint background hum of a public space is audible. (2) A sharp mechanical 'pop' sound effect triggers as the main character inserts a straw into a juice carton. The background music remains continuous and dominant, maintaining its high-energy rhythmic drive. The percussive quality of the BGM complements the crisp sound effect. (3) Another distinct 'click' or 'pop' sound occurs as a second straw is inserted. There is no change in the music's tempo or vocal delivery. Faint incidental rustling from packaging handling is mixed into the track under the main pop melody. (4) Subtle digital 'whoosh' sound effects accompany visual transitions between different products. The music continues its major-mode progression with prominent electronic textures. The overall spectral weight is bright, emphasizing the high-frequency vocal and synth layers until the track fades.
